description: The entity does not select, develop, and perform ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.
applicability: Applies to all entities when control monitoring is not performed, control testing is absent, internal audits are not conducted, or there is no evidence of evaluating control effectiveness.

metadata.detection_notes: Review control monitoring procedures, control testing schedules and results, internal audit plans and reports, management self-assessments, and evidence of ongoing control evaluations. Look for absence of control testing, lack of monitoring activities, or no evidence of control effectiveness evaluations.
